hooks.name: aidlc-sync-workflow-state
hooks.description: Keeps the workflow's Current Stage in aidlc-state.md in step with what has actually happened, so the status line and progress display stay accurate. DELIBERATELY matched to the shell tools, not a task/spec tool: neither surface hands a hook a task payload a sync could parse, so the hook derives the stage from the audit tail (do not 'optimize' this to a task matcher). All three shell spellings are matched because the engine verbs run through whichever one the host sends, and a missing spelling silently stops the sync on that host. Cost: the audit tail is read on every shell call; the hook self-gates idempotently so re-reads are correctness-safe, and the read is bounded by audit size.
